annotations.title: Verify an exported Intentrax proof against pinned keys

description: Verify an exported proof package (the JSON from GET /v1/proofs/{id}/export or the console's Export button) against Intentrax's published production and sandbox keys, using the same verifier as `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --json`. Pure computation: no network call, nothing is stored. status PASS means every signer is a published trust-bearing key and the signer threshold is met; SANDBOX_NON_TRUST_BEARING means the mechanics check out with sandbox keys only; FAILED_CLOSED means integrity or a signature did not verify. PASS does not show that an external effect happened; the result's verification_assessment and limitations list what was and was not assessed.

proof_export.description: The exported proof lookup package, as a JSON object (up to 1 MiB).
